acceptanceScope: Independent sampled encoded visual review only; audio, lyric-vocal synchronization and technical playback acceptance are outside this verdict.

evidence.method: Visual inspection in chronological order of every phrase, opening and outro sheet, followed by all transition and generated-section sheets. Eight native frames and eight390px-wide resized images inspect the repaired reading states. This judges actual decoded images, not source family labels or structural branch counts.
limitations: This is sampled decoded chronology, not uninterrupted full-speed watching.
No listening, vocal-sync or audio-quality claim is made.
A5fps sequence can miss very short artifacts and cannot fully establish30fps easing smoothness.
Phone-size assessment uses390px-wide stills and small contact-sheet frames, not actual phone playback.
Visual spelling checks do not independently certify the exact210-word transcript against a canonical source; the separate technical/transcript audit owns that check.
Motion-family boundaries involve judgment. Conservative grouping deliberately combines cosmetic differences.

Conservative grouping yields31 mechanisms with maximum reuse3. No remaining major visual defect was identified in the inspected evidence.

scoreReasons.lyricLegibility: Clear settled reading states across all39 phrases. Native and390px checks confirm the repaired cup/wine, follow/shall, no, for/you and generated mercy passages. Some intentional letter transformations briefly deform already-readable words, and partial letters during write-on are expected.
scoreReasons.semanticMotion: 31 conservative visual mechanisms with maximum equivalent use3. Growth, moving shadow projection, structural letter arch and material mercy now add observable actions. Guidance, steps, footfalls, table, protection, oil, cup, orbit and doorway reinforce meaning. Several effects remain restrained and fine-lined, so the result is not uniformly spectacular.
scoreReasons.photorealism: Convincing contemporary clothing, home/care settings, rain, wet materials and natural light. Reviewed hands, faces and body poses show no major anatomy defect. Most people are still photographic plates with camera movement, rather than sustained live human action.
scoreReasons.composition: Words occupy photographic wall, foliage, water and doorway space, with clear hierarchy and protected faces. The new arch and large mercy materially broaden the compositions. A recurring serif/italic palette and quiet two-row holds remain intentional stylistic repetition.
scoreReasons.continuity: All11 sampled act transitions, all3 generated sections and their neighboring states are coherent, without sampled black gaps, broken joins or misplaced duplicate mercy words. A brief registered glyph crossfade is visible at the material handoff.5fps sampling cannot prove every30fps transition or easing detail.

confidence: High on the visible repairs, spelling/reading states, photographic composition and reviewed joins; moderate on exact perceptual-family boundaries and sub200ms/full30fps motion continuity.
